toc.title: Disputatio iuridica. De iis dominia rerum acquirendi modis, quae descendunt ex iure gentium
Dn. Ioanni Christophoro Friderico I.U. Doctori eximio, & in alma Lipsiensi Advocato causarum patrono primario
Thesis I. Iure gentium dominia acquiruntur vel per apprehensionem vel per accessionem
Captura, personas & res bello justo captas, capientibus adjudicat.

book: A single Latin disputation (Disputatio iuridica) printed at Halle in 1613 and defended at Leipzig, on the modes of acquiring ownership that arise from the law of nations. It is built as a title page, a dedication, a preface (Praefatio), numbered theses with commentary, and a closing Finis; the sheet shows only Thesis I and one unnumbered thesis, so the total number of theses cannot be read from it.
